popup_unsupported: Browser pages and extension stores can't be translated
opt_privacy: Settings and keys stay on this device
opt_main_only_desc: Skip navigation, menus, buttons, headers, footers and code identifiers, i.e. the page's interface text. When off, all text on the page is translated.
opt_float_ball_desc: Show the draggable Bilingo button at the edge of web pages
builtin_desc: Uses the on-device translation model built into Chrome 138+ / Edge 148+: free, offline, and your text never leaves your device. Each language pair downloads a language pack on first use.
builtin_unsupported_alert: This browser doesn't support built-in translation. Please choose another engine.
local_desc: Runs an open translation model on your GPU: free, offline, and your text never leaves your device. The model downloads once and then loads from the local cache; it unloads after 10 idle minutes to free VRAM. Requires desktop Chrome / Edge with WebGPU.
local_no_webgpu_alert: This browser doesn't support WebGPU, so the local LLM can't run.
local_custom_repo: Hugging Face repo ID (an ONNX text-generation model that Transformers.js can load; prompted in the Hy-MT format)
local_custom_untested: Custom models are untested; translation quality depends on the model.
local_state_connecting: {mb} MB downloaded, connecting to the download server…
local_none_found: No files for this model on this device
model_hymt_desc: Tencent's translation model released in May 2026: 33 languages, the best balance of size and quality (community ONNX conversion)
model_tg_desc: Google's translation model: 55 languages, higher quality but slower and needs more VRAM (6 GB or more recommended)
openai_desc: Your API key stays in this browser. Requests go directly to the endpoint you enter, never through a third-party server.
openai_models_found: {n} models found; pick one from the input's suggestions
openai_prompt_placeholder: e.g. Always translate “agent” as “智能体”; keep a natural, conversational tone.
openai_ollama_before: When using Ollama, start it with the environment variable
openai_ollama_after: or its requests will be blocked by CORS.
azure_desc: Create a Translator resource in the Azure portal with the free F0 tier (2 million characters per month), then enter its key and location/region below.
azure_region: Region (e.g. eastasia; leave blank for global resources)
deepl_desc: Sign up for a DeepL API Free account to get a key. Free keys end with :fx and automatically use the free endpoint.
google_desc: No setup needed. Uses the free endpoint of Google Translate's website; your network must be able to reach Google.
sites_desc: One domain per line, e.g. news.ycombinator.com. These sites are translated automatically when opened.
cache_desc: Translated paragraphs are cached on this device, so pages you revisit load instantly.
prov_builtin_desc: The offline model built into Chrome / Edge; text never leaves your device
prov_local_desc: Runs an open translation model on your GPU, with better quality
prov_azure_desc: Microsoft's cloud translation; needs an Azure key
prov_deepl_desc: Excellent for European languages; needs a DeepL key
prov_openai_desc: DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Ollama or any compatible API
ball_title: Bilingo: translate / show original (Alt+A). Drag to move
err_ai_format: Unexpected response from the AI API: {data}
err_need_base_url: Please enter the AI API base URL in settings
err_need_model: Please enter a model name in settings
err_need_api_key: Please enter an API key in settings
err_need_azure_key: Please enter your Azure Translator key in settings
err_need_deepl_key: Please enter your DeepL API key in settings
err_builtin_pack: The language pack for {pair} isn't downloaded yet. Click the Bilingo button on the page to retry, or click “Download” in the extension settings.
err_builtin_unsupported: This browser has no built-in AI translation (needs desktop Chrome 138+ or Edge 148+). Please choose another engine in settings.
err_not_background: The {id} engine doesn't run in the background
err_no_offscreen: This browser can't run the local LLM (it needs the offscreen API of Chrome / Edge; Safari isn't supported yet)
err_no_webgpu: This browser doesn't support WebGPU. The local LLM needs Chrome / Edge 113 or later.
err_webgpu_disabled: WebGPU is currently disabled in the browser (no GPU available). Open {page} to check the WebGPU status. If it shows “GPU process crashed”, fully quit the browser (including background processes; consider turning off Startup Boost) and reopen it, and make sure “Use graphics acceleration” is on in settings.
err_webgpu_software: The browser only offers software-emulated WebGPU (no hardware acceleration), which can't run the local LLM. Please check {page}.
err_inference: Inference failed (the GPU may have been reset); the model will reload on the next translation: {msg}
picker_hint: Hover and click an area of the page · Esc to cancel
picker_saved_exclude: Saved. This area won't be translated on {host}.
picker_saved_include: Saved. Only this area will be translated on {host}.
menu_pick: Choose what to translate on this site
rules_desc: Fix how Bilingo handles a specific website: which areas to translate or skip, and CSS to repair layouts. The easiest way is “Choose what to translate…” in the popup.
rules_include: Translate only these areas (CSS selectors, one per line)
rules_exclude: Don't translate these areas (CSS selectors, one per line)
rules_css: Custom CSS (applied while the page is translated)
yt_no_captions: This video has no captions to translate
opt_yt_desc: Show the translation under the original subtitles. Turn it on or off with the Bilingo button in the player's control bar; uses the caption track selected in YouTube's CC menu.
